chapter: Lee and Lester Young band remembered
title: Dancer Marie Bryant
summary: He praises the dancing of Marie Bryant.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Marie Bryant. Everybody liked her. She was a monkey woman, you know... Do you know what a monkey woman is? It's not a pretty woman. "There's nothing in Chicago..."
"There's nothing in Chicago that a monkey woman..."

"...that a monkey woman like you can do." She just wasn't... She wasn't beautiful. She was hardly acceptable. A great, big, wide mouth, you know, and all that. She had very pretty eyes, and very beautiful inside, and her heart and everything -- she was just gorgeous. But from the waist down, look out. Gangbusters. And she could

dance, boy. The only person that could dance like her was when Dorothy was dancing. Dorothy could dance that way. Dorothy could be a hell of a dancer. But Marie Bryant would throw these guys into a loop.
She's in that Jammin' the Blues, that film...
Yes, she sings and she dances, with a guy named Archie Savage -- I think he's her partner in that.
Archie Savage... I don't think I know him. I knew a...I knew an awful lot of guys. I knew this one guy that...
